expectations.text: The empty-state instruction contains all 3 parts: what to look for, violation, correct
expectations.evidence: What: empty state screen with ?fixture=empty. Violation: text only with no illustration. Correct: illustration/graphic alongside text.

expectations.text: The transition instruction specifies what to look for, what's wrong, what's right
expectations.evidence: What: route navigation. Wrong: white flash/blank frame/abrupt jump. Right: continuous transition without blank frame.

expectations.text: The gutter instruction specifies breakpoints, what's wrong, what's right
expectations.evidence: Breakpoints: 320px, 768px, 1024px, 1440px. Wrong: uneven gaps. Right: uniform spacing in both axes.

expectations.text: No instruction is a vague one-liner
expectations.evidence: All three are multi-sentence with concrete criteria.

expectations.text: Each instruction is specific enough for deterministic pass/fail
expectations.evidence: Empty state: presence check. Transition: observable artifact. Gutter: measurable spacing.

expectations.text: All three blocks have appropriate scope, group, and priority fields
expectations.evidence: Scopes: Shelf (all three). Groups: empty-state, motion, layout. Priority: 2 for all.
